source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 256 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 256 was established by Ordinance No. 19352, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 5, 1986. Ordinance No. 19352 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19352 was amended by Ordinance No. 24832, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 23, 2002. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19352; 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 256 is established on property generally fronting on the west line of Vilbig Road, north of the north line of Fort Worth Avenue. The size of PD 256 is approximately 47.6 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19352; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 256A). (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711; 25759)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.105. USES.

The only permitted uses on the Property are auto auction, outside salvage and reclamation, and utility or governmental installation other than listed. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy.

(b) All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times.

(c) A full verdant screening must be maintained along Vilbig Road at all times.

(d) An irrigation system must be installed along Vilbig Road to facilitate and maintain the verdant screening.

(e) The director of development services shall make a landscaping and irrigation progress report to the member of the city council and the plan commissioner for District 1 on or before July 1, 2002. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.107. SCREENING.

Screening must be provided in accordance with Section 51-4.214, except as otherwise approved by the board of adjustment on April 13, 1982, in case number BDA 81-282-A/5646. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.108. HEIGHT.

Maximum height permitted on the Property is 40 feet. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.109. FLOOR AREA.

Maximum permitted floor area on the Property is 65,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.110. SETBACKS.

The setback from the northern and eastern boundary lines of the Property is 150 feet. The setback from the western and southern boundary lines of the Property is 25 feet. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.111. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage is 40 percent. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.112. PARKING.

Parking must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Ingress/Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.113. INGRESS/EGRESS.

Vehicular access may be provided only as shown on the development/landscape plan. All wrecker traffic must enter and exit the site via the Commerce Street intersection with Vilbig Road, and may not use Vilbig Road between the entrance to the site and Ft. Worth Avenue. A sign must be erected at the exit point from the site indicating that wrecker traffic must turn left, as noted on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.114. MAINTENANCE.

The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance at all times. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.115. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business districts contained in Division 51- 7.400. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.116. LIGHTING.

No lighting for the facility may produce glare or direct illumination across the property line of the residential properties on the east side of Vilbig Road. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.117. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development and use of the Property must be in compliance with all other applicable codes and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24832; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-256.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 256 is located on Zoning Map No. K-6. (Ord. Nos. 19352; 25711)
